item.title: Georgia Crossover Day 2026 sees several bills pass last minute
item.description: Georgia lawmakers worked late into the night Friday at the State Capitol for Crossover Day. This is the critical deadline for any piece of legislation to pass its chamber of origin and stay alive for the remainder of the session.It was a busy day of debate as dozens of proposals hit the floor, covering everything from prosecutorial oversight to police body cameras.
